command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PIMaterial_OP.OPModel.Commands.MoveMTU
command.description: This command registers the Movement which has involved the MTU specified as input of the command. A total move is performed when the entire quantity of the MTU is moved from a piece of Equipment to another. If you specify a Source Quantity which is greater than the actual Source MTU Quantity, the system will move the Source MTU entirely and the missing Quantity will be provided at the destination. If the Destination Equipment has either a FIFO or MIXING Material Behavior (without any content yet in terms of MTU) the move operation results in changing the location of the MTU from one piece of Equipment to another. If the Destination Equipment has a MIXING Material Behavior and already contains an MTU, the quantity of the existing MTU is changed, adding the source quantity in accordance with the mixing action. The source MTU is deleted. A partial move is performed when a partial quantity of the MTU, is moved from one piece of Equipment to another. The Source MTU Quantity is updated by subtracting the partial Quantity, which must be less than the total Quantity of the Source MTU. If the Destination Equipment, with either FIFO or MIXING Behavior (in this case without any content yet in terms of MTU) the move operation results in creating a new MTU inside the Destination location, with the same characteristicts as the Source MTU. If the Destination Equipment has a MIXING Material Behavior and already contains an MTU, the quantity of the existing MTU is changed, adding the quantity in accordance with the mixing action.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PIMaterial_OP.OPModel.Commands.MoveMTUFromSource
command.description: Moves the entire or a partial quantity of an MTU from a specific source (Equipment or MTU) to a specific destination Equipment, according to the Material Behavior of the source and destination: * FIFO (First In, First Out): the specified piece of Equipment receives the MTUs in input and stores them as individual entities. Whenever an MTU must be picked from the piece of Equipment, by default, the system will pick the MTU that was received in input and stored first. If a SourceQuantity is set as input of the command and the first MTU does not have enough quantity, subsequent MTUs are chosen untill the requested quantity is reached. * Mixing: the specified piece of Equipment receives the MTUs in input and combines them to form a single MTU, so it can contain one only MTU.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PIMaterial_OP.OPModel.Commands.Move
command.description: This command registers a single Movement which has happened in the system, involving one single Source MTU specified by MTUId input field. If no source exists in the system, MTUId can be left empty: for tracing purposes it is still possible to specify the SourceEquipmentNId value, but in this case no algorithm will be executed to retrieve a possible MTU from the specified source (use the MoveMTUFromSource command for this particular behavior instead). Use the DestinationEquipmentNId input field to set the natural identifier of the piece of Equipment that is the end point of the move operation. How the Equipment has been configured will ultimately affect how the MTU will move forward during the process execution: * FIFO (First In, First Out): the specified piece of Equipment receives the MTUs in input and stores them as individual entities. * Mixing: the specified piece of Equipment receives the MTUs in input and combines them to form a single MTU. The Quantity of the MTU is determined by the incoming contributions: the first contribution would set the reference Unit of Measure for the MTU, and all the other contributions will add up to its Quantity, their value being converted into the reference Unit of Measure, as long as each contribution of Material Quantity is expressed with a mutually compatible Unit of Measure. The first contribution whose Quantity would be eventually expressed with a Unit of Measure which is not compatible with the one already associated with the MTU, will cause the entire Quantity of the MTU to be reset (the Quantity will be set equal to NULL). If a the contribution of the source MTU is associated with a Material or a Material Lot which is different from the one already (optionally) associated with the MTU inside a Mixing piece of Equipment, the MTU will lose its Identity.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PIMaterial_OP.OPModel.Commands.GetDestinationEquipmetFromSourceEquipment
command.description: Starting from a Source Equipment, that must be included in an Equipment Flow, the command retrieves all the Equipment, contained in the flow, that can be used as destination for a move operation. Furthermore, specifying a Material or a Material Group, you can retrieve the list of destination Equipment that handle a specific Material or group of materials. ### Return codes * -10859: The piece of Equipment, identified by SourceEquipmentNId, does not exist * -10856: The Equipment Flow, identified by EquipmentFlowNId, does not exist * -11100: The source Equipment, specified by SourceEquipmentNId, does not belong to the Equipment Flow, identified by EquipmentFlowNId

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PIMaterial_OP.OPModel.Commands.SplitMTU
command.description: Takes part of the source Material Tracking Unit quantity (source quantity) to create a new MTU, which inherits Material, Material Lot, State Machine and Properties from the source. If an MTU Template is specified as input, the new MTU inherits its state machine and properties. If no quantity is specified as input (SplitQuantity.QuantityValue =0 or SplitQuantity.QuantityValue = NULL), the entire source Material Tracking Unit quantity is taken, setting the source MTU quantity to zero. The quantity that must be taken must be expressed with the same Unit of Measure of the source quantity. It is possible to use a different Unit of Measure only if it belongs to the same dimension. The command: 1. Decreases the source Material Tracking Unit quantity by the quantity given as input. 2. Creates a new Material Tracking Unit with the quantity given as input. The new Material Tracking Unit inherits the Material, Material Lot and Properties of the source and can be located in the same location (Equipment or Material Tracking Unit Aggregate) as the source. The command may return the following error codes, if some checks on input parameters fail: * Error -12100: the MTU, identified by NId, does not exist. * Error -12101: no quantity is specified for source MTU (NULL or zero). * Error -12102: the Unit of Measure used to express the SplitQuantity.QuantityValue is not compatible with the source quantity. * Error -12103: the quantity specified as input exceeds the source MTU quantity. The command may return the following error codes, during its execution: * Error -12104: If the creation of the new Material Tracking Unit fails. * Error -12105: If a failure occurs when decreasing the source Material Tracking Unit quantity.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PIMaterial_OP.OPModel.Commands.CreateMaterialLotProcessAdditionalProperties
command.description: Adds a Facet to the given MaterialLot Entity, adding process-related properties. This command checks if the MaterialLot exists, if not the error 12108 is returned. In case the command cannot calculate the value of the ExpiryDate attribute, error 12109 is returned. In case the command cannot calculate the value of the DLU attribute, error 12110 is returned.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PIMaterial_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateMaterialLotProcessAdditionalProperties
command.description: Updates the process-related Facet to the given MaterialLot Entity. If the respective Facet does not exist, this command creates it for the Material Lot. This command checks the MaterialLot 1. If it exists, if not the error 12108 is returned. 2. If it is Frozen, if so error 12111 is raised.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PIMaterial_OP.OPModel.Commands.ConsumeMTU
command.description: A part of the source Material Tracking Unit quantity is detached in order to be consumed in the production process. If the input quantity is not specified (ConsumeQuantity.QuantityValue = 0 or ConsumeQuantity.QuantityValue = NULL), the entire source Material Tracking Unit quantity is taken, setting the source MTU quantity to zero. The quantity that is going to be decreased must be expressed with the same Unit of Measure as the Material Tracking Unit quantity. You can use a different Unit of Measure only if it belongs to the same dimension. The command: *Decreases the source Material Tracking Unit quantity by the given input quantity. *Converts the UoM of the input quantity if different from MTU UoM, but belonging to the same dimension. *When completing, the command rises the event MTUOperationCompleted with the info about the quantity that has been decreased and the info about source MTU. The command may return the following error codes, **if some checks on input parameters fail**: *Error -12100: the MTU, identified by NId, does not exist. *Error -12101: no quantity is specified for source MTU (NULL or zero). *Error -12102: the Unit of Measure used to express the ConsumeQuantity.QuantityValue is not compatible with that of source quantity. *Error -12103: the specified input quantity exceeds the source MTU quantity. The command may return the following **error codes, during its execution**: *Error -12105: a failure is occurred when decreasing the source Material Tracking Unit quantity.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PIMaterial_OP.OPModel.Commands.SupplyMTU
command.description: Adds a quantity of material to a Material Tracking Unit. The quantity that is going to be added must be expressed with the same Unit of Measure as the Material Tracking Unit quantity. You can use a different Unit of Measure only if it belongs to the same dimension. The command: * Increases the Material Tracking Unit quantity by the given input quantity. * Converts the UoM of the input quantity if different from MTU UoM, but belonging to the same dimension. * Upon completion, raises the event MTUOperationCompleted which contains the info on the destination MTU and its new quantity. The command may return the following **error codes, if some checks on input parameters fail**: * Error -12100: the MTU, identified by NId, does not exist. * Error -12107: the action on the Material Tracking Unit (NId %MTUNId%) failed: the Supply quantity in input is null, or lower or equal to zero. * Error -12102: the Unit of Measure used to express the SupplyQuantity.QuantityValue is not compatible with that of source quantity. The command may return the following **error codes, during its execution**: * Error -12106: a failure occurred when increasing the Material Tracking Unit quantity.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PIMaterial_OP.OPModel.Commands.MigrateMaterialLotCreateAdditionalProperties

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PIMaterial_OP.OPModel.Commands.MoveMTUsToMTUAggregate
command.description: Moves one or more Material Tracking Units to a Material Tracking Unit Aggregate. The Command executes the following steps: 1. Retrieves the Material Tracking Units identified by their natural identifiers found in MaterialTrackingUnitNIds input parameter. 2. Retrieves the MTU Aggregate by the given natural identifier MaterialTrackingUnitAggregateNId. 3. Calls the MoveMaterialTrackingUnitToMaterialTrackingUnitAggregate Command for each MTU. 4. Fires an MTUOperationCompleted Event after each MTU moved to the Material Tracking Aggregate. The command checks: 1. if the MTU Aggregate exists, if not it returns the error -12113. 2. if each of the Material Tracking Units exists, if not it returns the error -12114. 3. if each MTU moving is successful: if one fails, it returns error -12241.

It is used for an MDUI operaiton, in the [Material Tracking Units] and [Material Tracking Unit] pages.

event.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PIMaterial_OP.OPModel.Events.MTUOperationCompleted
event.description: This event is fired when a manufacturing operation that involves an MTU (such as Move, CreateIdentity or RemoveIdentity) is completed. This event is fired with a specific envelope, on which you can filter while configuring the event subscription from Solution Studio: * Category: contains the identifier of the Functional Transaction * Topic: contains the identifier of the base Action (for example: Move, Create, Split, ...) * UserField1, ..., UserField10: the value of the first 10 Custom Fields, in the same order as they are passed as input to the Functional Transaction.
